server.heading: Mail server
server.description: Elysium runs one mail server for self-hosted mailboxes. It hosts any number of domains, all on the same ports.

empty.title: No mail server yet
empty.description: Creating one starts a Stalwart mail server on this host through Docker. Mail stays on this host until you make the server reachable from the internet.

failed.title: The mail server could not be created

unreachable.title: The mail server is not answering
unreachable.description: Domains and self-hosted mailboxes cannot change until it does. {{error}}

serverForm.title: Create mail server
serverForm.description: Elysium starts Stalwart in Docker and becomes its administrator. The administrator's password is stored encrypted and never shown.
serverForm.domainHint: Addresses end in it, such as agent@example.com. Add more domains later.
serverForm.hostnameHint: The name every domain's MX record points to. It needs an address record of its own once mail leaves this host.

errors.domainInvalid: Enter a domain such as example.com.
errors.hostnameInvalid: Enter a hostname such as mail.example.com.

domains.heading: Domains
domains.defaultHint: The domain the server was created with. It cannot be removed.

domainForm.title: Add domain
domainForm.description: The domain shares the mail server and its hostname with every other domain.
domainForm.name: Domain

errors.nameInvalid: Enter a domain such as example.org.

removeDomain.title: Remove {{name}}?
removeDomain.description: The mail server stops hosting it and deletes its DKIM signing keys.

dns.title: DNS records for {{name}}
dns.description: Publish these at your DNS provider for this domain to send and receive mail on the internet. Elysium looks them up in public DNS; it never changes DNS.
dns.loadError: The records could not be loaded.
dns.dkimPending: DKIM keys are generated a few seconds after a domain is added. Check again shortly.
dns.zoneFileHint: Includes optional service discovery records, as a zone file.

internet.title: Receiving mail from the internet
internet.description: Beyond these records it needs a public IP address with ports 25, 465, and 993 reachable, an address record and reverse DNS for {{hostname}}, and a TLS certificate for {{hostname}}. Providing those is up to you.

mailboxes.heading: Mailboxes
mailboxes.description: The mailboxes Elysium reads and sends mail from. Credentials are encrypted and never shown, and Gmail and Outlook passwords never reach Elysium at all.

availability.brokerMissing: Set OAUTH_BROKER_URL for the API in compose.yml to connect Gmail and Outlook accounts.

brokerUnreachable.title: The OAuth broker could not be reached
brokerUnreachable.description: Gmail and Outlook accounts cannot connect until it answers. {{error}}

availability.providerMissing: The OAuth broker does not offer {{provider}}.
availability.mailDomainMissing: Add a domain to the mail server first.

table.label: Mailboxes
table.empty: No mailboxes yet. Connect an account or create a mailbox to get started.

createForm.title: Create mailbox
createForm.description: A mailbox on Elysium's own mail server. Mail stays on this host: reaching the internet needs a real domain and DNS first.
createForm.domainHint: Add more domains under Mail server.
createForm.displayNameHint: Shown beside the address on sent mail. Optional.

errors.localPartRequired: Enter a name for the address.
errors.localPartInvalid: Use letters, digits, and . _ + - only, without a leading, trailing, or doubled dot.
errors.addressTaken: A mailbox with this address already exists.

renameForm.title: Change sender name
renameForm.hint: Shown beside {{address}} on sent mail. Leave blank to show only the address.

disconnect.title: Disconnect {{address}}?
disconnect.selfHosted: This deletes the mailbox from Elysium's mail server, along with every message in it. The address becomes available again.
disconnect.oauth: Elysium forgets this account and its credential. The mailbox itself is untouched, and you can also revoke Elysium's access from your {{provider}} account settings.

toasts.testPassed: {{address}} signed in to IMAP and SMTP
toasts.sendFailed: The test message could not be sent
toasts.connectFailed: The account could not be connected
toasts.serverCreateFailed: The mail server could not be created
toasts.copyFailed: The browser did not allow copying

oauthErrors.state_mismatch: The connection was started in another browser. Start it again from this page.
oauthErrors.flow_expired: The connection took longer than fifteen minutes or was already completed. Start it again.
oauthErrors.broker_unavailable: The OAuth broker is no longer configured.
oauthErrors.broker_refused: The OAuth broker refused to hand over the account.
oauthErrors.no_refresh_token: The provider did not grant lasting access. Try again and approve every permission.
oauthErrors.no_address: The provider did not share the account's email address.
oauthErrors.provider_unavailable: The OAuth broker does not offer this provider.
oauthErrors.address_in_use: That address is already connected as a different kind of mailbox.
oauthErrors.internal_error: Elysium could not save the account.
